summary: City page confirms $35/day (monthly $750 in summer, $600 in winter), water/electric/sewer, showers, restrooms and dump, and year-round use; written. Booking is now Campspot (21 RV sites listed; city-run), not phone only: platform phone -> campspot. Pin OK at the entrance. Not waterfront stands. Electric amperage and max_rig 50 cleared (aggregator only); count 25 left vs Campspot's 21.

No June 2027 night was open yet, so no price was quoted on Campspot.
SITE COUNT 25 (derived) vs Campspot 'RV Sites 21': not changed (an unlisted remainder may be monthly). Suggest 21 if AWH prefers the booking count.

MONTHLY: $750/$600 monthly rates on ~21-25 sites; imagery shows mostly travel rigs on the pull-through lanes and a few rigs at the east end. No residential signal I could see, but the monthly share is unknown.
PIN OK: 41.40435,-99.64855 is at the entrance on the north drive; the pull-through lanes run 30-110 m south.
WATERFRONT not waterfront confirmed: a small drainage channel (Mud Creek) runs ~60 m S of the pads beyond mown grass. It is a creek-scale ditch with no frontage.
